episode: Basement Conversion, The School Bus House
assessment: The strongest episode of the four so far. The reveal runs 25:53 to 36:29, roughly ten minutes, so for once footage is not the constraint and the job is choosing. The basement became a full second living space: family room, kitchen, laundry, bathroom, an added bedroom and storage. Three beats are genuinely surprising and carry the Short, outlets set into the concrete floor so no cord crosses to the wall, a recessed pan so the dryer sits flat against the wall, and an egress ladder in the new window well. Mike talks budget once at 33:39 and the cost slide runs after 38:14, both fenced off. There is easily a second Short in this episode if you want one.

project_context.summary: A basement turned into a self contained living space. Family room with an electric fireplace and outlets set into the concrete floor, a full kitchen with flat packed cabinets, a relocated laundry with a recessed dryer pan, a remodelled bathroom with glass shelves instead of a recessed niche, an added bedroom with a four foot window well and an egress ladder, baseboard heaters and thermostats per room, and a run of closet storage.
project_context.segment_choice: One Short, cut entirely from 25:53 to 36:20, the finished reveal. No before footage and no progress footage.
notes: Every frame is the finished space.
Nothing in the Short shows demo, workers, or price.
